children: Abdullah bin Zahran Al Hinai, CEO of National Bank of Oman, has resigned for personal reasons and will continue in his role until March 31, 2027.
The Board of Directors said that a succession plan will be announced ahead of Al Hinai’s departure.
Al Hinai joined NBO as CEO in August 2020, after spending more than 23 years at Bank Muscat, where he served as the Chief Wholesale Banking and Strategic Growth Officer before his departure.
(Writing by Bindu Rai, editing by Seban Scaria)

title: National Bank of Oman CEO resigns
